recommendation_summary: Keep nightly-sync on edna, run a self-hosted Healthchecks container on the Synology, have the script ping it at the end with exit-code handling, and let Healthchecks email the user when a ping fails or is missed.

labels.Requirements and who asked: fail alert without reading logs (you); use existing edna + Synology (you).
labels.Deleted: central log on Synology, Dockerize everything, success emails - upkeep with no alert when a startup crash skips email.
labels.Bottleneck: crash happens before the email step, so detection waits until you happen to look.
labels.Checked myself: only what you told me - 03:00 cron on edna, 4x startup crash on expired token, no email sent, no other alert.

note: The reply says it drops central logging and Dockerizing everything, but it still recommends a self-hosted Docker service (Healthchecks) on the Synology, which makes it LARGER.
